IRDAI Policyholder Protection Safeguard

In compliance with IRDAI (Protection of Policyholders’ Interests) Regulations, ClaimSathi operates strictly as an independent legal-medico advocacy firm. Chambers never intercepts or holds insurer claim disbursements. All claim funds remit directly from the insurer or Ombudsman registrar into the verified bank account of the policyholder.
